name: Celestia Native
author: Celestia Metal Contributors
description: Celestia’s built-in Metal shader suite with daylight and moonlight shadows, water, volumetric atmosphere, weather and filmic post-processing.

options.label: Sun and Moon Shadows
options.description: Renders near and far shadow cascades.

options.label: Shadow Map Resolution
options.description: Sets the texture resolution of each cascade.

options.label: Far Shadow Distance
options.description: Sets the far cascade half-width in blocks.

options.label: Far Shadow Update Interval
options.description: Sets how many frames may pass between far-cascade updates.

options.label: Shadow Softness
options.description: Controls the filter spread at shadow edges.

options.label: Ambient Occlusion
options.description: Adds contact shading around nearby surfaces.

options.label: Ambient Occlusion Strength
options.description: Adjusts the strength of contact shading.

options.label: Procedural Stars
options.description: Draws the procedural starfield and Milky Way.

options.label: Atmospheric Haze
options.description: Applies altitude-dependent scattering and mist to distant terrain.

options.label: Haze Density
options.description: Scales the density of the terrain haze.

options.label: Shaded Water
options.description: Enables water refraction, depth absorption and reflection.

options.label: Animated Waves
options.description: Bakes long waves and fine ripples into tiled textures.

options.label: Wave Strength
options.description: Adjusts the height and tilt of the small waves.

options.label: Sea Swell Strength
options.description: Adjusts long open-water waves.

options.label: Water Reflections
options.description: Chooses sky only, or adds screen-space reflections for nearby terrain.

options.label: Reflection Strength
options.description: Adjusts the intensity of reflected light.

options.label: Screen-Space Reflection Budget
options.description: Caps the number of depth intervals per ray. Larger values retain more detail.

options.label: Screen-Space Reflection Distance
options.description: Limits each above-water reflection ray in blocks.

options.label: Caustic Strength
options.description: Controls the bright patterns cast onto the bottom by refracted light.

options.label: Shore Foam Strength
options.description: Adjusts foam along shallow shorelines.

options.label: Volumetric Clouds
options.description: Uses volumetric clouds when Minecraft clouds are enabled. Turning them off here keeps Minecraft cloud rendering.

options.label: Cloud Samples
options.description: Sets the Fancy cloud sample count. Fast uses a smaller count.

options.label: Cloud Layer Thickness
options.description: Sets the height of the cumulus layer in blocks.

options.label: Cloud Density
options.description: Adjusts cloud coverage and opacity.

options.label: Cloud Drift Speed
options.description: Scales horizontal cloud motion.

options.label: Volumetric Light Shafts
options.description: Scatters sun and moon light through air using the shadow cascades.

options.label: Volumetric Light Samples
options.description: Sets the number of light samples per ray.

options.label: Volumetric Light Strength
options.description: Adjusts the brightness of shafts.

options.label: Surface Weather
options.description: Enables wetness, puddles, snow, raindrop ripples and lightning illumination.

options.label: Color Look
options.description: Chooses the filmic color grade.

options.label: Bloom
options.description: Adds a glow around bright parts of the scene.

options.label: Bloom Strength
options.description: Scales the glow blended into the scene.

options.label: Exposure Compensation
options.description: Brightens or darkens the metered exposure in EV.

options.label: Color Saturation
options.description: Scales the color saturation of the selected grade.
